# AITWIRE

> AITWIRE is an Agentic AI Marketing and Advertising Platform that helps businesses win valuable customers and clients. AITWIRE coordinates owned, earned and paid marketing — from how AI assistants describe and recommend a business, and the approved content behind those answers, to advertising and offers.

This is the index. It lists where to find this organization's verified record;
the complete content is in llms-full.txt.

## Full record
- [llms-full.txt](https://aitwire.com/llms-full.txt): the complete consolidated record as prose — 3 FAQs, 26 verified facts, team, locations.

## Structured data
- [entity.json](https://aitwire.com/.well-known/entity.json?tenant=aitwire): the canonical typed record — identity, offers, claim types, validity window and integrity metadata.
- [ai.txt](https://aitwire.com/.well-known/ai.txt?tenant=aitwire): this organization's AI usage and attribution policy.
- [ai-bundle.html](https://aitwire.com/.well-known/ai-bundle.html?tenant=aitwire): the same record as crawl-grade HTML with embedded JSON-LD — one fetch, every section.
- [sitemap.xml](https://api.aitwire.com/feeds/sitemap.xml?tenant=aitwire): every published surface for this organization.
- [articles.rss](https://api.aitwire.com/feeds/articles.rss?tenant=aitwire): article feed, newest first — use this for freshness.
